tokens.name: Abomination
tokens.rule: An Abomination entering play follows normal Character entry rules and cannot Attack that Turn unless another effect grants Hothead.
tokens.purpose: The oversized payoff for sacrificing hand size and the laboratory battery.

tokens.name: Specimen
tokens.rule: A Specimen may be represented by an approved external TCG card. Its original game's text, stats, cost, color, rarity, abilities, and rules have no effect in Unhinged. If a physical external card representing a Specimen leaves play, set it aside as used instead of putting it in an Unhinged zone.
tokens.purpose: Preserves the visual gag of cross-TCG cards without importing another game's rules engine.
